note: R-109 review artefact read by hooks/git-workflow-guard.sh at the PR head. The controls under review are the guard and lock changes of the governance pruning (protected-path-guard collateral-test ask, tdd.sh RED classes and test formatting, verification-gate expected-red, security-surface and build-lane prose exclusion, git-workflow-guard reviewed tail, log-rule-fire session field) and the removal of non-security hooks. Six rounds ran; round 6 found nothing above LOW, which ends the review under the 1:1 budget's security exception. Every finding below is fixed in range with a fixture feeding the control its insecure value, or waived by the owner. The review of the head that adds this file is the PR body's Security review section.
